tests.exercises: 2-D metallic TaS2: pw.x SCF then ph.x at Gamma. Covers 2-D Coulomb cutoff with a metallic occupancy in PHonon/PH/.
tests.why: Suitable. Added as check ph-2d-metal (revision 4, 2026-09-15). Measured sum 24.6 + 128.0 = 152.6 s on the x86 worker, over the leaf's 60 s check window; this deck reads a single explicit q vector (no ldisp grid), and a measured start_irr=1,last_irr=1 subset (22.7 s) never reaches ph.x's dynamical-matrix diagonalization, so no knob produces a gradable frequency under 60 s. One of four ph_base checks (section 7): Si Gamma with epsil. Graded groups: energy, eigenvalues, phonon, dielectric, born. Gamma acoustic modes need a separate post-ASR bound or exclusion (Phase A 8.891e-01 cm^-1 vs 0.05 cm^-1 provisional). Entrypoints: ph.x.

tests.exercises: Silicon at X: the same pw.x SCF as the Gamma chain, then ph.x at q=(1,0,0) on Si.pz-vbc.UPF. Finite-q DFPT without the Gamma acoustic-sum-rule issue.
tests.why: Selected. Measured sum 0.29 + 1.73 = 2.02 s; all steps Passed. policy=pointwise, chaotic=false (DFPT is not a chaotic time integration). One of four ph_base checks (section 7): Si X, finite-q DFPT without the Gamma ASR issue. Graded groups: energy, eigenvalues, phonon. Entrypoints: ph.x. tests.exercises: FCC Ni at X with PAW: collinear spin-polarised pw.x SCF (nspin=2, tprnfor) then ph.x at X on Ni.pbe-spn-kjpaw_psl.1.0.0.UPF. Heaviest ph_base chain (65.87 s).
tests.why: Not selected. Retired in revision 3: the chain runs ph.x with trans=.true. and no epsil, so phonon frequencies are the only DFPT quantity it produces; measured phonon floor_allowed=0.4135418323880913 cm^-1 from allowed-startingwfc-random; 100x that is 41.35 cm^-1, 20.7 times the upstream 2 cm^-1 cap, so the group cannot be graded under the revised CURATOR-DECISIONS section 6 rule of 2026-09-11. After that drop the check graded only energy and forces — quantities any correct SCF reproduces — and could not fail on the physics its module owns. Magnetic-plus-PAW DFPT coverage moves to ph-insulator-paw-magn-o2, whose deck sets epsil=.true. runtime_measured remains true (65.87 s); retired for grading, not for time.

Graded groups: energy, eigenvalues, phonon, lambda (lambda.x and interpolated frequencies; drop lambda if the floor is large, section 6). Entrypoints: ph.x, q2r.x, matdyn.x, lambda.x.

tests.exercises: SiC Gamma restart: pw.x SCF, ph.x recover=.false. (wipes _ph0), then three ph.x recover=.true. steps that keep _ph0 (driver code 10).
tests.why: Suitable. Added as check ph-restart-sic (revision 4, 2026-09-15). Measured sum 0.2 + 0.3 + 0.3 + 0.3 + 0.2 = 1.4 s on the x86 worker. All six candidate groups (energy, eigenvalues, dielectric, born, phonon, phonon_acoustic) survive with full headroom; the official deck's documented ph.x STOP 1 partial-convergence signal on its four niter_ph=5 restart calls is tolerated by this check's own run.sh copy, which still fails on a real CRASH file.

tests.exercises: Two-chemical-potential phonons of Si: two pw.x+ph.x pairs, ph.x via driver code 11 (wipe _ph0, skip if CRASH).
tests.why: Suitable. Added as check ph-twochem (revision 4, 2026-09-15). Measured sum 0.1 + 0.9 + 0.2 + 1.2 = 2.4 s on the x86 worker. Both independent configurations (pair1, pair2) are ground-state-only after floor-dropping (allowed-mixing-beta-0.3/allowed-startingwfc-random drive eigenvalues and phonon/phonon_acoustic past their caps on both pairs); energy, forces and stress remain graded per pair. The official decks share QE's default prefix; this check's extract.py copy keys every group by pair identity instead of letting the second pair overwrite the first.
